selection_rationale: An all-3g torpedo fleet: 24 rounds of 18 GJ each, fired together to overwhelm any 4-hull enemy's point defence. Every hull is fast, so we can pick the range and outrun slow gun capitals after launch. The frigate adds 2 PD turrets and a gun to screen and finish damaged ships.
formation_rationale: The cheap Picket frigate goes forward as the vanguard. It will spot targets and take the first exchange. The three Stilettos sit in a shallow wedge behind it, staggered sideways and vertically so a spinal weapon can't line up more than one of them at a time. Every ship stays within about 100 km of the others, so their point defence still overlaps against torpedoes.
